description.name: Entry
description.text: Causes [Imperil Lightning 20% (15s)], grants [Buff Lightning 20% (15s)] to all allies, grants [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Garnet (Lightning)], [Thundering Dark Ability Tracker] and [Thundering Dark Level] to the user

description.name: Buff Lightning 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases Lightning damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Garnet (Lightning)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Thundering Dark (0~2), removed after using Thundering Dark two times

description.name: Thundering Dark Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Thundering Dark level by 1 after using 7 Summoning or Bard abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Garnet (Lightning)]

description.name: Thundering Dark Level
description.text: Keeps track of Thundering Dark level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Garnet (Lightning)]
